leadText: Matthew Mitler is an American actor and voice actor for the English-language dub of Pokémon the Series.
plainText:
Matthew Mitler is an American actor and voice actor for the English-language dub of Pokémon the Series.

== Pokémon roles ==
Mitler initially voiced a few characters on from the first season to the third season. He briefly returned during the ninth season to voice Keenan and Kerrigan, but has not voiced any characters since.
===Animation===
==== ====
=====Major=====
Rudy
Falkner

=====Minor=====
Chopper

Hitmonchan Trainer
Hisashi
Keenan
Kerrigan
